title: BellRing Brands Announces CFO Transition
body_markdown:
ST. LOUIS, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BellRing Brands, Inc. (NYSE:BRBR) (the “Company”) today announced that Travis Leonard has been appointed to succeed Paul Rode as Chief Financial Officer (“CFO”), effective December 1, 2026. Mr. Rode is stepping down after a successful career of over 10 years leading the finance team at BellRing and will serve in an advisory capacity through February 28, 2027.


Mr. Leonard brings more than 25 years of financial leadership experience, including prior service as CFO in the consumer products industry. He has a strong track record of driving financial performance, strengthening operational rigor, applying disciplined capital allocation and scaling profitable growth across multichannel businesses. He was most recently with Lockton, Inc., the world’s largest privately held independent insurance brokerage, where he served as CFO. Previously, he was CFO of Hostess Brands and served as the CFO of the Medical segment at Cardinal Health. Earlier in his career, he spent nearly 14 years in finance roles of increasing responsibility at Kraft Foods and held finance and corporate audit roles at Cargill. He began his career at Arthur Andersen as a finance and economic consultant.


“We are excited to welcome Travis to BellRing. His extensive experience in consumer products, public company financial leadership and disciplined capital allocation will be invaluable as we execute our strategy to strengthen profitability and drive sustainable growth,” said Mike Axelrod, President and Chief Executive Officer of BellRing. “I also want to thank Paul for his outstanding contributions over the past decade, including his leadership through our IPO and significant growth. I appreciate his partnership during my transition and his commitment to ensuring a smooth handoff.”


“I am honored to join BellRing,” said Travis Leonard. “BellRing is a leading company in the proactive wellness category with the #1 ready-to-drink protein brand, strong customer relationships and high consumer loyalty and is well positioned to drive long-term growth. I am excited to partner with Mike and the broader BellRing leadership and finance organization to continue to ensure disciplined execution and deliver long-term value for stakeholders.”


“It has been a privilege to serve BellRing over the past decade and to work alongside such a talented team,” said Paul Rode. “I am proud of what we have accomplished together and of the strong financial foundation we have built. I have great confidence in Mike, Travis and the entire BellRing team, and I look forward to supporting a seamless transition.”

**About BellRing Brands, Inc.**


BellRing Brands, Inc. (NYSE: BRBR) is a dynamic and fast-growing consumer brands business with the purpose of Changing Lives with Good Energy. Focused on growing the proactive wellness category, the company’s brands include *Premier Protein* , the #1 ready-to-drink protein and proactive wellness brand, and *Dymatize* , the brand behind the #1 hydrolyzed protein powder. A culture-driven, pure-play company, BellRing Brands believes nutrition is at the core of a healthy world and produces products with best-in-class nutritional profiles and exceptional flavors. Its products are distributed in over 90 countries across club, mass, food, eCommerce, specialty, drug and convenience.
